name: soul_dream
description: First call returns a context packet (needs_thought). Second call records >=2 imagined outcomes. Does not write identity.

task_context.description: Task bucket used for RPE expectation matching (e.g. 'deploy-db-migration'). Same key later scores dreams against reality.

outcomes.description: At least two imagined outcomes (strings or branch objects). Omit to receive the context packet. Branch objects may carry 'likelihood' (-1..1, signed predicted valence) so reality scoring can compute a dream-RPE.
